reason: This is a planner/executor semantic revert around unifying fast plan cache and normal plan cache. Even with only 4 core code paths, plan cache behavior is central to prepared statement planning, invalidation, execution-path selection, and runtime correctness. Reverts in this area can hide Blocker/High issues such as wrong-plan reuse, stale cache eligibility, or executor/compiler mismatches, so it merits a deep review.
